config_policy: atomic only when disarmed, RF disarmed and all consumers/producer contexts drained, no frozen or pending banks; padding must be zero
binding_policy: clock/time/MTS/map/binding/interlock dwell and normalized feedback remain trusted external inputs
result_policy: command success after actual module response; REPLAY success is queue acceptance, later reject held until REJECT_POP; STATUS is coherent RF snapshot
awg_commit_policy: A loaded COMMIT returns BUSY without dispatch or table loss unless acquisition is stopped, active mode is MUTE, replay and generated sources are drained and detector is inactive. This prevents single-inflight gateway deadlock behind a future STOP. Unloaded COMMIT still returns REJECTED from the AWG core. BEGIN and WRITE may target the inactive bank while RF runs.
pdw_policy: PEEK returns 20 words: count32,dropped32,head_token64,CAPTURE_PDW512. POP requires exact head_token64 or returns REJECTED. Queue full drops only PDW with saturating count; hard reset flushes, soft capture reset preserves events. No DMA completion or RF emission is implied. Tokens never wrap: exhaustion drops new PDW until hard reset.
source_event_policy: PEEK14 words: count,dropped,token64,record320; exact-token POP. Observe mutually exclusive actual DDS/AWG acceptance; freeze command sequence and active TX config. Require matching done and actual sources_drained. First cancellation reason retained, within-cycle priority safety then STOP/reset then MUTE. Times denote observation cycles, not source sample or DAC/RF timing; flag1 requires time_valid at both observations and nonwrapping order, otherwise both times zero. Queue full drops event only; saturated drops also count malformed overlapping/invalid acceptance. Hard reset discards active observation and queue; capture soft reset preserves records. Tokens start1, never wrap; exhaustion drops new events. No DAC/FIR tail, RF emission, replay or DMA completion is implied.
rf_fault_policy: Actual interlock fault_latched rising edges only, independent of source activity. PEEK12 words count/drop/token64/record256; exact-token POP. Flags time1 config2, invalid fields zero. Inputs bits0..9 binding,timing,hard_fault,PLL,heartbeat,PA_fb,TR_fb,RX_protected_fb,arm,request. Outputs bits0..5 PA_req,TR_req,RX_protect_req,DAC_mute,RF_permit,unbound. Snapshot is at observation after latch assertion, not root cause or physical RF timing. Held high does not repeat, clear allows a new assertion but retains history. First high after hard reset is recorded; capture soft reset preserves records. Queue16 drops new records when full without backpressure, saturating drop count; tokens start1 and never wrap.
aux_policy: CAPTURE words=count32,TXtoken64: current qualified sample onset, group4 only, one reserved metadata slot. PEEK25=status32(valid bit0, ready bit1,busy bit2)+96byte immutable sidecar. POP2 exact metadata_id32/epoch_id32 join. Metadata POP never returns RAW; source role/calibration qualification supplied by trusted RF-domain binding; unbound rejects.
